remedies-take-herbs.title: Take the herbs
remedies-take-herbs.description: Take named plants as ingredients of a remedy.
remedies-take-herbs.matchRule: Take named plants for a remedy; record the plants on the occurrence.

remedies-give-seven-days.title: Give the herbs for seven days
remedies-give-seven-days.description: Give a prepared remedy to the patient over a stated number of days.
remedies-give-seven-days.matchRule: Give a remedy to the patient over several days; record the duration and timing.

remedies-steep-sift.title: Steep and sift the bulbs
remedies-steep-sift.description: Steep ingredients in a liquid and sift them.
remedies-steep-sift.matchRule: Steep remedy ingredients in liquid and sift or strain them.

remedies-sew-into-cord.title: Sew into a cord from a leopard’s kill
remedies-sew-into-cord.description: Sew a remedy ingredient into a cord or strip of leather.
remedies-sew-into-cord.matchRule: Sew or enclose an ingredient in a leather cord; record the source animal.

remedies-twist-sinew.title: Twist in the sinew
remedies-twist-sinew.description: Twist an animal sinew into a cord.
remedies-twist-sinew.matchRule: Twist a sinew into a cord or amulet.

remedies-heat-compress.title: Heat and apply a compress
remedies-heat-compress.description: Heat a compress and apply it to the patient.
remedies-heat-compress.matchRule: Heat a compress or pad and apply it to the patient.

remedies-crush-into-bag.title: Crush the plants into a bag
remedies-crush-into-bag.description: Crush plants and store them in a bag.
remedies-crush-into-bag.matchRule: Crush remedy plants; record any container.

remedies-entrust-to-stars.title: Entrust it to the stars
remedies-entrust-to-stars.description: Leave a remedy outdoors overnight under the stars.
remedies-entrust-to-stars.matchRule: Leave a remedy outdoors overnight; the stars or night must be stated.

remedies-carry-into-house.title: Carry it into the house
remedies-carry-into-house.description: Carry a remedy indoors after exposure.
remedies-carry-into-house.matchRule: Carry a prepared remedy into a building.

remedies-into-honey.title: Give it in honey until he recovers
remedies-into-honey.description: Mix a remedy into honey and give it to the patient.

remedies-gut-fish.title: Gut a fish
remedies-gut-fish.description: Take a fish and remove its inner parts for a remedy.
remedies-gut-fish.matchRule: Gut a fish as a remedy ingredient.
